Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: liyiming.709
Message:
feat(advanced-quant): Sprint 1-3 五大新模块 — 把系统升级到组合经理 + 风控官 + 执行交易员

按用户书单和实操路线建议自主推进。一次实现 5 个 service + 集成到 sizing 流程
+ API + 单测 + 前端 UI。

- 复用既有 OverfitMetrics.DSR/PBO 纯函数
- 新增 scanFileForLookahead — 正则扫 7 种未来函数模式（Date.now / getFuture* /
  getNextBar / forward_return / future_high / next_day_*）
- 新增 detectSurvivorshipBias — universe drift 检测
- computeOOSDecayRatio — IS/OOS sharpe 比值；> 3 即 FAIL
- 综合 verdict (PASS/WARN/FAIL/INSUFFICIENT)
- 持久化 ResearchIntegrityAudit 表
- 51 个单测全绿

- 4 子分量 fillable_score 0-100:
  - limit_proximity_score (权重 30%) — 涨跌停距离
  - volume_coverage_score (权重 30%) — target_qty / avg_5d_volume
  - spread_score (权重 20%) — (high-low)/close 价差
  - status_score (权重 20%) — T+1 / 停牌 / ST / 涨跌停硬约束
- 决策: fillable (>=70) / risky (30-70) / blocked (<30 or hard_block)
- 支持 4 个市场段涨跌停幅度 (main 10% / chinext-star 20% / bj 30% / st 5%)
- 持久化 ExecutionFeasibilityRecord 表
- 44 个单测全绿

- López de Prado AFML 第 3 章 Meta-Labeling 范式
- 12 维特征: signal_score / source one-hot (3) / regime one-hot (4) /
  market_breadth / strategy_winrate / strategy_payoff / market_atr
- 自实现 Logistic Regression 训练 (GD + L2 reg)
- 训练数据源 RecommendationTradeOutcome (closed)
- Fallback: 无模型时用规则 signal_score / 100 × regime_multiplier
- 持久化 MetaLabelDecision 表
- 30 个单测全绿

- 4 method:
  - risk_parity (默认) — Maillard-Roncalli ERC cyclic coordinate descent
  - min_variance — 投影梯度下降
  - max_sharpe — mean-variance 投影梯度上升
  - equal_weight — 1/N baseline
- 约束: 单股 [min, max] / 行业 max_industry_weight (默认 40%) /
  total_allocation (默认 95%)
- 自动估算 covariance from daily_returns (or accept directly)
- 持久化 PortfolioConstructionResult 表
- 32 个单测全绿

- 取代二值 StrategyKillSwitch，引入 5 档:
  - healthy (Kelly × 1.0)
  - cautious (× 0.7) — drawdown ≥ 6% / sharpe30d ≤ 0.5 / winrate ≤ 50%
  - defensive (× 0.4) — drawdown ≥ 12% / sharpe30d ≤ -0.3 / winrate ≤ 40%
  - critical (× 0.2) — drawdown ≥ 18% / sharpe30d ≤ -0.8 / winrate ≤ 30%
  - observe_only (× 0.0) — drawdown ≥ 25% / sharpe30d ≤ -1.5
- 集成到 PaperTradingAutomationService.decideSizing hard cutover:
  effectiveTargetPct *= governor.getCurrentMultiplier(portfolio_id)
  < 0.5% 自动 skip
- 与 DrawdownCircuitBreaker 互补 (Governor 软调节，CircuitBreaker 硬触发)
- 持久化 EquityCurveGovernorState 表 + 内存 cache (TTL 5min)
- 31 个单测全绿

- 5 个 service 共享一个 AdvancedQuantController + advancedQuant.routes
  (mount /api/advanced-quant)
- Endpoint 总计: 18 个新 endpoint
- 前端: LabWorkspace 新增「高级量化」tab，集成 5 个子面板（卡片堆叠 + 表单
  操作 + 表格展示）
- TypeScript 编译 0 error，前端 build 通过

- 5 个新 service 共 188 tests, 0 fail
- 全量测试 84 pass / 8 fail (8 个 fail 在 factors/strategies，pre-existing
  日期相关，与本次改动无关，main 分支同样 fail)

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: liyiming.709
Message:
feat: US-068 - 运维：环境一致性脚本与 .env 验证

新增 EnvValidator (joi-based) + check-env CLI + 107 单元测试，让 production 启动前
对 7 类必填 env 完整校验，缺失立即 exit(1) 防止半夜 missing config 启起来留 zombie
service。

- backend/src/config/EnvValidator.ts (254 LOC): validateEnv → EnvValidationResult
  { ok, errors[], warnings[], validated, node_env }; 不 throw 让 caller 自由决定
  exit 还是 warn. 4 类字段分类: REQUIRED_ALWAYS (DB / Redis / JWT / TradingAgents)
  / REQUIRED_PRODUCTION (JWT_SECRET >= 32) / OPTIONAL_WARN_IF_MISSING (4 channel
  groups) / OPTIONAL_NO_VALIDATION (开关). 部分填写 channel group = error;
  PLACEHOLDER_VALUES 字典检测 (production = error / dev = warning).
- backend/src/scripts/check-env.ts: CLI 入口走同份 validateEnv, exit 0/1.
- backend/src/index.ts: dotenv 后立即跑 validateEnv → 打印 errors/warnings →
  shouldExitOnFailure 在 production 立即 exit(1). 必须在所有其他 import 之前.
- backend/.env.example: 从 36 行扩到 95 行覆盖全部 7 类 env 段每段加注释解释何时填.
- backend/tests/config/env-validator.test.ts (380 LOC, 107 ok / 0 fail):
  PLACEHOLDER_VALUES 冻结 / 4 channel group 冻结 / isPlaceholderValue /
  detectPartialChannelGroup / mapJoiErrorsToValidationErrors / format functions /
  validateEnv e2e (缺必填 / 占位符 / 部分填写 / 端口非法 / 默认值注入 / 未知 env) /
  shouldExitOnFailure 4 路径.
- package.json + npm run check-env CLI script.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
